minutes.headline: Commission continued the Lake Shirley herbicide and drawdown hearing and backed the Saliba land purchase.
minutes.summary: After an executive session, the Commission continued several hearings to October 2 and spent a long stretch on the Lake Shirley Improvement Corps herbicide and drawdown notice of intent with its consultant. A workshop was set for the following Wednesday. It voted to support the Saliba land warrant article and an APR purchase, issued an enforcement order at 141 Vo Street, and denied an extension for 101 Pleasant Street.

what_happened.line: The Commission continued the Lake Shirley herbicide and drawdown notice of intent and set a workshop on its conditions for the following Wednesday at 7:00.
A recommendation that the Selectmen fully support the Saliba land acquisition warrant article was moved; the vote result was not audible in the captions.
The Commission moved to issue an enforcement order at 141 Vo Street for a recharge trench and to deny an extension for 101 Pleasant Street; results were not audible.
The consultant was to draft clarifications on data collection and drawdown before the next hearing.
The 915 Northfield Road notice of intent was continued to October 2, and the DPW culverts hearing was moved to continue to the same date.

why_it_matters: The Lake Shirley treatment plan and the Saliba land purchase both involve town spending and conditions on a public water body, and each is headed to further public steps where residents can weigh in.
Most vote outcomes in these minutes were not audible, so the recorded motions show what was moved, not necessarily what was adopted.
watch_next: October 2, 2019: continued hearings, including Lake Shirley, 915 Northfield Road and DPW culverts, are set to resume.
The Lake Shirley workshop on conditions, set for the Wednesday after this meeting at 7:00 and posted as an agenda item.
